title: The Hag's Bane
summary: Tear-stained Journal teaches the Hag’s Bane formula.

fields.Read: Read to reveal the recipe. Combine Ashes of Dried Fey Flower and any Essence. Throw the resulting grenade at Auntie Ethel to make her disgorge Vanra alive.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
